rooms.name: 2.7 THE MIX

fallReturn43._why: NIGHT45 A2 (A-4, DECIDE43 D-5; the GANTRY's rule): feet under -0.3 m in the grate (the lava at -0.8) -> back on the apron 2 m before that pit's near edge, facing the grate again, 10 health, a short fade: a missed dash-jump costs the run-up, never the fight.
